action.hypothesis: Screening the four highest-proposal-score GMC-guided children will yield lower far-field risk and worst-sector leakage than their parents, advancing the guided rescreening step of the discovery cycle.
action.expected_observation: Cached GMC returns per-design risk and far-field metrics; at least four GMC-guided designs become evaluated, advancing the guided cycle gate.
action.decision_reason: The discovery cycle requires rescreening GMC-guided progeny from the second generation before further regeneration or MC; the genvr per-call cap allows only four evaluations, so screen the top four guided candidates awaiting screening.

action.hypothesis: These four GMC-guided children, each placing absorbers at the high-importance [3,4] and [4,3] cells while removing low-sensitivity absorbers, should reduce far-field tail and worst-sector leakage versus their screened parents.
action.expected_observation: Cached GMC returns per-design risk and far-field metrics, raising the gmc-screened count from 8 to 12 and satisfying the minimum GMC batch gate before any MC certification.
action.decision_reason: The guided cycle is passed but the minimum GMC batch (10) is unmet at 8 screened; this per-call-cap-respecting batch of four unevaluated guided candidates closes that gap without touching the locked MC stage.

action.hypothesis: The GMC top-ranked design d7d960548ee7 will demonstrate a statistically significant reduction in far-field neutron flux and tail hotspots versus the baseline under unbiased Monte Carlo certification.
action.expected_observation: Unbiased Monte Carlo returns far-field confidence intervals for d7d960548ee7; we expect its far_mean, far_cvar90, far_max, and worst_sector_mean to lie at least 1.96 standard deviations below the baseline, satisfying the verifier's separation criteria.
action.decision_reason: The GMC-guided discovery cycle is complete (12 GMC-screened, 8 GMC-guided-and-screened), so the next required fidelity gate is unbiased MC certification. d7d960548ee7 has the lowest GMC risk and far-field metrics among all screened candidates and is queued for MC; certifying it now uses one of two exact-candidate slots to secure physical evidence for the leading design.

arguments.summary: Design d7d960548ee7 (GMC-guided gmc_path_importance progeny from parent fed6d69cffdf, moving absorbers to high-importance cells [3,4]/[4,3]) passed the required genvr-cfm-response -> unbiased-mc chain. Unbiased global MC over 4 replicates at 56x56 gives candidate/baseline far-field 0.108 (89.2% reduction, difference_z -37.26, 95% CI separated) and deep far-field 0.773 (22.7% reduction, z -2.89, CI separated), meeting the verifier's separation criteria. GMC risk (0.083) was the lowest of 12 GMC-screened candidates and consistent with the MC result; no split-cap saturation occurred, so the certification is not distorted by population control.

action.hypothesis: The lowest-GMC-risk GMC-guided design remains a genuine full-field far-field and tail-hotspot improvement under unbiased Monte Carlo.
action.expected_observation: Independent verifier confirms verified_improvement for d7d960548ee7 and accepts termination.
action.decision_reason: The GMC-guided discovery cycle is complete (12 GMC-screened, 8 GMC-guided-and-screened) and one design now has separated unbiased-MC far-field and deep-far-field intervals versus baseline. The MC root-history budget is fully exhausted (0 remaining), so no further certification is possible; the rational stop is to submit the single critically certified candidate for verification.
